title: Prove limb binding radii cover the sampled metaball envelope
description: The implicit welded-surface binder currently derives each limb segment's influence radius from Thickness.Evaluate at the segment midpoint, while LimbMetaballSampler samples many metaballs along the same segment with radius = Thickness.Evaluate(t). This can under-cover segments with strongly varying thickness even when geometry is valid. Replace the midpoint proxy only after proving the binding radius is a conservative envelope of the actual sampled limb metaball radii and preserves deformation locality. Do not add a generic padding heuristic.
